description: This PHP source file defines classes and functions related to XML Schema handling for the ADOdb Database Abstraction Layer. It includes classes for representing database objects, tables, indexes, data, query sets, and schema parsing/executing methods. It supports XML schema parsing, conversion, and SQL generation to create or modify database schemas based on XML specifications.

classes.name: dbObject
classes.description: Base class for database objects, providing common methods for handling support platform, prefixing, and ID extraction.

classes.name: dbTable
classes.description: Represents a database table, including methods to add fields, indexes, generate CREATE/ALTER SQL, and manage table schema elements.

classes.name: dbIndex
classes.description: Represents a database index, allowing configuration of index columns, options, and creation SQL.

classes.name: dbData
classes.description: Represents data for a database table, with methods to add data rows, generate insert/update SQL, and manage data content.

classes.name: dbQuerySet
classes.description: Manages a list of SQL queries, enabling building, prefixing, and creating SQL command sets.

classes.name: adoSchema
classes.description: Main class for loading, parsing, converting, and executing XML Schemas for database schema creation and migration.

methods.name: setUpgradeMethod
methods.description: Sets how existing database objects are upgraded, e.g., ALTER, REPLACE.

methods.name: existingData
methods.description: Configures how data conflicts are handled during import: insert, update, ignore.

methods.name: executeInline
methods.description: Enables or disables inline execution of SQL statements during schema parsing.

methods.name: parseSchema
methods.description: Loads an XML schema file and generates SQL to create or update the database schema.

methods.name: parseSchemaString
methods.description: Parses a string containing the XML schema into SQL statements.

methods.name: convertSchemaString
methods.description: Converts an XML schema string to a different DTD version.

methods.name: create_parser
methods.description: Creates an XML parser with handler callbacks for schema parsing.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Handles XML start elements during schema parsing.

methods.name: _tag_cdata
methods.description: Handles character data inside XML elements during schema parsing.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Handles XML end elements during schema parsing.
